# The genomics pack

*Genomics* · version 1.0.0 · code `GENOMICS`

## What it is

The four kinds the genomics module's screens read: `variant`, `sample`, `gene` and `cohort`. They are the tables `genomics.variant`, `genomics.sample`, `genomics.gene` and `genomics.cohort` of the lake `genomicslake` (`config/lakes/genomicslake.yaml`), served by the Delta connector `genomics-store`. The module opens no VCF file: your files go through the genomics loader (`tools/loaders/genomics`) into the lake, and the module reads the lake.

The demo data is `data/testdata/genomics/<kind>/` (the module's synthetic samples: 120 variants, 24 samples in two cohorts, eight genes), written by `python3 tools/packgen/genomics_module/make.py` and built into `genomicslake` by `drishti.py lake demo`.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `variant`

read through connector `genomics-store`.

About: Variant.

**Id:** set by its connector (no samples ship).

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `genomics-store` (plugin `delta`).

read through connector `genomics-store`.

About: Sample.

read through connector `genomics-store`.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `genomics-store` | `delta` | `variant`, `sample`, `gene`, `cohort` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`.

## Refreshing the data

Your own data: drop your VCF files and gene, sample or cohort tables in the loader's inbox and run `python3 tools/loaders/genomics/genomics_run.py` (the guide *Load your own genomics files*); the module reads the new rows at most a minute later. The demo data: `python3 tools/packgen/genomics_module/make.py` writes `data/testdata/genomics`, and `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` builds it into the lake.

The data feed `clinvar` (config/feeds/clinvar.yaml) pulls `variant`: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run clinvar` fetches them daily into `data/datafeeds/clinvar/<date>/` and loads them into the lake `genomicslake`; `--dry-run` says what it would fetch, changing nothing; `feed status` shows the last runs. The External data feeds guide (docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) has the schedule entries for Linux and Windows.

The data feed `ensembl` (config/feeds/ensembl.yaml) pulls `gene`: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run ensembl` fetches them daily into `data/datafeeds/ensembl/<date>/` and loads them into the lake `genomicslake`; `--dry-run` says what it would fetch, changing nothing; `feed status` shows the last runs. The External data feeds guide (docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) has the schedule entries for Linux and Windows.

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/genomics_module/make.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
